The Graduation Evening

Tuesday evening – an experience like no other.

Tuesday, August 18 · Starts 6:00 PM Pacific · All guests are welcome

For many participants, Tuesday Evening Graduation is the most memorable part of The Forum. You'll come back together with the people you've shared the weekend alongside — and with the family, friends, and colleagues you choose to invite — for an evening of celebration, acknowledgment, and possibility.

It's a chance to celebrate what you've created — and to share that moment with the people who matter most to you.

Invite another guest
A few simple agreements that make The Forum work for everyone.
  • Be present for the full day, start to finish.
  • Arrive on time for each session and stay through the close.
  • Give the room your full attention — set phones, devices, and other distractions aside.
  • Keep what others share confidential and treat everyone with respect.
  • Please don't record, screen-capture, or share any part of the event.
Good to
know.
How do I join each session?
Use the green Join Your Forum button — it's at the top of this page and in the menu bar throughout the weekend. It opens your Zoom room directly.
When should I log in each day?
The room opens at 8:30 AM each morning, in the time zone of your Forum. Plan to arrive at least 15 minutes before the 9:00 AM start so you're settled when we begin.
What if I get disconnected?
Just click Join Your Forum again to come right back in. If you have ongoing trouble, reach our team using the contact details below.
Where do I find each day's assignment?
Right here on this page, in the “Your assignments” section. Each day's assignment appears the morning it opens, with the newest at the top.
Can I invite guests to graduation?
Yes — Tuesday Evening Graduation is open to the family, friends, and colleagues you'd love to have there. Use the Graduation section above to invite them.
What if I need to transfer my course?
No problem — plans change. Contact us at info@landmarkworldwide.com or +1 (800) 888-9590, and for a small $35 administrative fee we'll transfer you to another course date that works for you.
Who do I contact if I need help?
Our support team is here throughout. You'll find our email and phone in the Contact section just below.

Support

Taking care of yourself

This weekend can be full and rich, and sometimes big feelings show up along the way — that's a natural part of looking honestly at your life. Whatever comes up for you is welcome here.

Simple ways to take care

A few things make a real difference: make sure you're getting good sleep, eating and drinking well, and regularly standing up to move your body. Take a deep breath and look around the room when you need to. Take care of yourself along the way, and reach out whenever you need to.

You don't have to do it alone

If something feels like a lot, please reach out — to a friend, to someone you trust, or to a member of our team. We're here and always glad to support you.

If you'd like to talk to someone right now

Landmark is a personal and professional development company, not therapy or medical care. If you're in distress or simply want immediate, confidential support, these free resources are available any time, day or night:

  • 988 — Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
    Call or text 988 · 24/7 · free & confidential
  • Crisis Text Line
    Text HOME to 741741 · 24/7 · free
  • SAMHSA National Helpline
    Call 1-800-662-4357 · 24/7 · treatment referral & information
  • Find a Helpline
    findahelpline.com · free, confidential support in your country
In any life-threatening emergency, call 911 or go to your nearest emergency room.

Thank you for bringing yourself to this experience. Take good care.
